## Validation

List the exact checks performed, including PowerShell versions, static analysis,

## Safety Checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to one logical purpose.
- [ ] I read and followed the affected project's README and local rules.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, tenant identifiers, customer data, exports,
      logs, local configuration, or generated artifacts.
- [ ] Read-only defaults and explicit execution gates remain intact where applicable.
- [ ] I updated documentation for behavior, prerequisites, permissions, parameters,
      or output changes.
- [ ] I documented any check that could not be run.
- [ ] I agree that this contribution may be distributed under `GPL-3.0-only`.
